command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 grades a ticked-but-undone task as WARNING. tasks.md 2.3 is ticked [x] and says 'also assert, with `createInMemoryLocationBackend`, that the saved document has no `meeting` key after the command'. packages/client/src/test/features/meeting_range/steps/meeting_range_wall_times.steps.ts uses only createMeetingWorld() and has no backend assertion. The review marks 2.3 ❌ and calls it 'a task ticked but not done', yet labels R2 WARNING; the acceptance criteria name 'a ticked-but-undone task' as a CRITICAL case. R2 should be CRITICAL, the Summary should show CRITICAL 1, and the Verdict ('Ready. Nothing is CRITICAL.') must change to match.

R4 cites `packages/client/src/views/grid/MeetingHandle.tsx:96-98`, but those lines are the slider JSX (`<div role="slider" tabIndex={0} aria-label={presented.label} …`). The JSDoc the Problem describes ('Implements FR9, FR10, FR12, NFR-A1, NFR-A2, NFR-R1, UX1, UX2 of' / 'Implements FR6, FR7 of fix-grid-meeting-range-lock-and-layering (D5).' / 'add-grid-meeting-range-and-share (D6).') is at lines 42-44.
